arguments.value: Beijing SINA and SINA Leju agree to end their prior domain name license agreement immediately. From the signing date of this termination agreement, the old agreement is fully canceled and none of its terms remain in effect. The document also says it is the entire agreement on this termination, can only be changed in writing, is governed by PRC law, may be signed in counterparts, and binds the parties and their successors.
